hyperedges.label: Handwriting Rendering Pipeline (sanitize -> rich syntax -> layout -> render/animate)
Custom Font Creation Flow (sketch/template -> vectorize -> TTF -> apply)

nodes.label: bindUIActions() — no inline handlers
nodes.rationale: All UI handlers are attached via addEventListener (v1.6.4+); HTML contains no inline onclick/onchange attributes.

nodes.label: CSS Design Tokens & Theme System
nodes.rationale: CSS Custom Property system enables precise light/dark theme switching without runtime layout recalculations.

nodes.label: layoutText(text) — Unified Layout Engine
nodes.rationale: Single source of truth for character coordinates ensures identical layout between static renders and animation — previously a source of visual discrepancy.

nodes.label: Debounced Rendering (debounceRender, 280ms)
nodes.rationale: Typing never re-lays-out per keystroke — editor changes trigger a 280ms trailing debounce around renderText(S.text).

nodes.label: SSE Streaming AI
nodes.rationale: AI responses stream word-by-word into the canvas in real time, preventing UI freezing.

nodes.label: Content-Security-Policy meta (defense-in-depth)
nodes.rationale: Locks scripts/styles/fonts to pinned CDNs and outbound calls to the three AI endpoints; SRI-pinned CDN libraries.

nodes.label: getCharVariation() — Realism Engine
nodes.rationale: Individual character rendering (vs full-word) creates far more realistic handwriting at the cost of slightly more computation; offsets scale with fontSize/22 and S.realism to eliminate jagged artifacts.

nodes.label: Indic Script Rendering (whole-word blocks)
nodes.rationale: Indic words render as a single block to preserve Devanagari shaping rules; heavy rotation would sever connected matras and shirorekha joins.

nodes.label: Seeded PRNG (mulberry32 + FNV-1a hash)
nodes.rationale: Guarantees 100% deterministic layout and rendering across re-renders, page navigations, and PDF exports.

nodes.label: 10 Paper Styles (ruled, clean, plain, grid, legal, vintage, dark, dot_grid, engineering, music)
nodes.norm_label: 10 paper styles (ruled, clean, plain, grid, legal, vintage, dark, dot_grid, engineering, music)

nodes.label: Paper Grain Texture Shader
nodes.rationale: Randomized micro-rectangle noise adds subtle organic paper texture for handwritten authenticity.

nodes.label: Baseline Parity with DOM Editors
nodes.rationale: DOM top padding formula ensures 100% pixel-perfect alignment between DOM page-editor text and paper ruled lines without vertical text jumping.

nodes.label: Web Speech API — Voice to Notes
nodes.norm_label: web speech api — voice to notes

nodes.label: callAI() Provider Router
nodes.rationale: Previously the four AI actions were hardcoded to callClaude() and silently ignored the Ollama provider selection

nodes.label: Ollama Local Provider
nodes.rationale: 100% private client-side REST call requiring no API key

nodes.label: escapeHtml()
nodes.rationale: Prevents XSS when injecting user content into innerHTML

nodes.label: getGlobalTextFromEditors()
nodes.rationale: textContent + pre-wrap gives a 1:1 lossless round-trip between page editors and S.text (v1.6.19)

nodes.label: IndexedDB Glyph Storage (draftedGlyphs)
nodes.rationale: Migrated custom character drafts from localStorage to IndexedDB to bypass the 5MB browser quota limit

nodes.label: Version Drift Guard (check-versions)
nodes.rationale: package.json, sw.js CACHE_VERSION, and the index.html cache-bust query share one version to prevent stale service-worker caches

nodes.label: RDP Curve Simplification
nodes.rationale: Drops redundant coordinates on straight segments while preserving handwriting curves

nodes.label: Static Hosting Model
nodes.rationale: No build step, no server, no backend — deployment is just serving the static app files

nodes.label: Modal Focus Trapping
nodes.rationale: Enforce WCAG 2.1 keyboard accessibility by cycling Tab/Shift+Tab within modal boundaries and restoring focus on close

nodes.label: Zero-Dependency Single-File Philosophy
nodes.rationale: No build tools, all code runs directly in the browser, CDN-only dependencies, works offline once loaded; the single-file architecture is intentional

nodes.label: Blank-Glyph Hygiene (pruneBlankGlyphs)
nodes.rationale: Blank glyphs otherwise render as invisible characters; pruning runs on boot and after imports

nodes.label: API Key Local-Only Storage Rule
nodes.rationale: Users must provide their own API key stored only in localStorage; never ship a key inside the repo

nodes.label: Three-Place Version Pinning & Cache-Busting
nodes.rationale: Skipping the version bump risks clients being served stale code from the service worker's cache-first asset cache

nodes.label: Warm Terracotta Orange Circular Minimalist Emblem Style
nodes.norm_label: warm terracotta orange circular minimalist emblem style

nodes.label: Inkwell and Fountain Pen Visual Motif
nodes.norm_label: inkwell and fountain pen visual motif

nodes.label: Canvas Screen-Reader Inaccessibility Constraint
nodes.rationale: Handwriting rendering to canvas is fundamentally visual; the textarea + Render path serves as the accessible equivalent

nodes.label: AI_SYSTEM_BASE_PROMPT
nodes.rationale: Instructs AI engines to output Inkflow's native structured study syntax so notes render as handwritten notebook pages

nodes.label: resequenceQA()
nodes.rationale: AI models misnumber flashcard questions and repeat near-identical questions within a session

nodes.label: sanitizeAiResponse()
nodes.rationale: Raw markdown symbols break the aesthetic of handwritten notes

nodes.label: Smart Arrange
nodes.rationale: Since v1.6.7 runs fully offline via deterministic smartArrangeLocal() and needs no provider or API key

nodes.label: SSE Streaming (callClaude)
nodes.rationale: Text appears word-by-word as the AI generates it, preventing UI freezing

nodes.label: requestAnimationFrame Draw Loop
nodes.rationale: Single RAF loop with no timers and no per-frame buffer copies for performance

nodes.label: bindUIActions()
nodes.rationale: Replaced all inline onclick/onchange/oninput HTML attributes with addEventListener bindings

nodes.label: drawCursiveConnector() (Deprecated)
nodes.rationale: Synthetic Bezier ligature drawing disabled to prevent baseline artifacts in favor of native font vector connections

nodes.label: getResponsiveCanvasWidth()
nodes.rationale: Canvas display width was previously hardcoded regardless of viewport, causing misalignment between ruled lines, worksheet header, and editor overlay on mobile

nodes.label: Seeded mulberry32 PRNG (hashString/createPRNG)
nodes.rationale: Keyed on notebook id + text so re-renders, page switches, and PDF exports produce pixel-identical output

nodes.label: Editor Marker Round-Trip Fix (v1.6.21)
nodes.rationale: Editor-to-textarea sync wrote \uFFF0/\uFFF1 placeholders back, permanently replacing sticky/callout marker syntax in source text

nodes.label: Human Handwriting Realism Engine (v1.6.22)
nodes.rationale: Replaced mechanical pixel-identical character rendering with controlled seeded organic variation

nodes.label: Human Variation Model (getCharVariation)
nodes.rationale: Each character is rendered slightly differently (tilt, scale, baseline, spacing, pressure, opacity) to emulate human handwriting

nodes.label: Animation/Export WYSIWYG Consistency
nodes.rationale: On completion the canvas is finalized through the normal renderText() path, guaranteeing consistency between animation and exported output

nodes.label: parseRichSyntax Placeholder Re-entry Guard (v1.6.4)
nodes.rationale: layoutText() re-invokes the parser internally and a second pass would wipe the first pass's parsed sticky/callout entities

nodes.label: updateEditorStyles()
nodes.rationale: Dynamically calculates firstLineBaseline so DOM text baseline aligns perfectly with canvas ruled lines

nodes.label: Persistent Page Canvases
nodes.rationale: Characters are drawn once onto each A4 canvas and stay there; re-renders occur only on setting changes, not scroll/export.

nodes.label: Two-Column CSS Grid Layout (sidebar + canvas area)
nodes.norm_label: two-column css grid layout (sidebar + canvas area)

nodes.label: Ink Bleed Simulation (drop shadow)
nodes.rationale: Drop shadow ink bleed is computationally inexpensive via the canvas shadow API and avoids complex pixel-level blending.

nodes.label: Debounced Autosave (1000ms)
nodes.rationale: Writes are batched and non-blocking: autosave() debounces 1000ms before serializing settings to localStorage and the notebook to IndexedDB.

nodes.label: IndexedDB InkflowDB (draftedGlyphs + notebooks stores)
nodes.rationale: Custom glyphs and notebooks live in IndexedDB to bypass the 5MB localStorage quota and keep localStorage small.

nodes.label: Perfect Decoupling (state S vs render loop)
nodes.norm_label: perfect decoupling (state s vs render loop)
nodes.rationale: The central config state S is decoupled from the rendering loop; updates simply change S and trigger a canvas repaint.

nodes.label: Blob-Based Export Architecture
nodes.rationale: Replaced html2canvas screenshot capture with native canvas.toBlob(); Blob URLs resolved Chrome download tray invisibility for files over 2MB

nodes.label: Pre-Export State Handling
nodes.rationale: Blurs the active page editor and awaits 320ms for the blur/redraw cycle so exports capture clean canvas state

nodes.label: 2x High-Resolution Upscaling
nodes.rationale: Produces ~150 DPI output from the 794x1123 native canvas for sharper exports
